answer: Submission rate is limited to 9 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole fleet from one uplink. An operator running many aliases thus forfeits for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the trellis quota and the nadir admission check. Because the counters live in the tundra ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
